`windowOf` (src/out_json.zig:89-121) returns null in these cases:

1. `w == 0`, meaning no column limit (src/out_json.zig:90).
2. The event has no match span, `ev.span` is null (src/out_json.zig:91).
3. The text already fits: `ev.text.len <= w` (src/out_json.zig:92).
4. The span is out of range: `sp.end > ev.text.len` (src/out_json.zig:93).
5. The emitted text is not the original line: `ev.text` differs from `ev.line_bytes`, e.g. with `--replace` (src/out_json.zig:94; test at src/out_json.zig:578-583).

Callers also skip the call when `max_columns` is 0 (src/out_json.zig:154). In every null case, the row is emitted whole with `ev.text` and no `win_start`/`line_len` fields (src/out_json.zig:183-193).
